Dear Sir/Madam, 
 
Pursuant to the provisions of Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure 
Requirements) Regulations, 2015, link of audio recording of Investors & Analysts Conference Call held

and Nine Months ended September 30, 2026) is as follows:
